sentences.en: New housing is built on the outskirts of the city.
sentences.zh: 新住房建在城市的郊区。

sentences.en: Industrial areas tend to be on the outskirts of cities.
sentences.zh: 工业区往往位于城市边缘。

sentences.en: My home is on the outskirts of that city.
sentences.zh: 我家就在那座城市的郊区。

senses.zh: 郊外,市郊，郊区,从外围经过,边缘
